questions.questionText:
If
 in a code language "EXAMINATION" is written as "125"
 then how will “HARDWORK” be written in that language?
questions.questionHtml: If in a code language "EXAMINATION" is written as "125" then how will “HARDWORK” be written in that language?

options.rawHtml: 68
86
89
98

questions.solutionText:
The
 logic followed here is: 

 Logic:
 Sum of the positional value of letter. 

 For, 

 "EXAMINATION"
 is written as "125" 5+24+1+13+9+14+1+20+9+15+14 = 125 

 Similarly,
 HARDWORK = 8+1+18+4+23+15+18+11 = 98.

The logic followed here is:

Logic: Sum of the positional value of letter.

For,

"EXAMINATION" is written as "125" 5+24+1+13+9+14+1+20+9+15+14 = 125

Similarly, HARDWORK = 8+1+18+4+23+15+18+11 = 98.
